arabian-nights-burton-1885-vol-06.description: Vol. 6 of Sir Richard Burton's unexpurgated 1885 literal translation of the Alf Layla wa Layla — the most famous and most cited English rendering of the Arabian Nights, with Burton's terminal essay and notes. arxiv-1605-06148.title: Remote Operations and Nightly Automation of The Red Buttes Observatory
arxiv-1605-06148.creator: David H. Kasper, Tyler G. Ellis, Rex R. Yeigh, Henry A. Kobulnicky, Hannah Jang-Condell, Mark Kelley, Gerald J. Bucher, James S. Weger
arxiv-1605-06148.description: Abstract We have implemented upgrades to the University of Wyoming’s Red Buttes Observatory (RBO) to allow remote and autonomous operations using the 0.6 m telescope. Detailed descriptions of hardware and software components provide sufficient information to guide upgrading similarly designed telescopes.

arxiv-1809-00122.title: Meromorphic Solution of the Degenerate Third Painlevé Equation Vanishing at the Origin
arxiv-1809-00122.creator: Alexander V. KITAEV
arxiv-1809-00122.description: Abstract We prove that there exists the unique odd meromorphic solution of dP3, u ⁡ ( τ ) u(\tau) such that u ⁡ ( 0 ) = 0 u(0)=0 , and study some of its properties, mainly: the coefficients of its Taylor expansion at the origin and asymptotic behaviour as τ → + ∞ \tau\to+\infty .

arxiv-2105-09231.title: On Cosymplectic Conformal Connections
arxiv-2105-09231.creator: Punam Gupta
arxiv-2105-09231.description: Abstract Abstract. The aim of this paper is to introduce a cosymplectic analouge of conformal connection in a cosymplectic manifold and proved that if cosymplectic manifold M admits a cosymplectic conformal connection which is of zero curvature, then the Bochner curvature tensor of M vanishes. Mathematics Subject Classification. 53C05, 53C18, 53C20 53D05. Keywords. Kähler manifold, Sasakian manifold, Cosymplectic manifold.

arxiv-2106-00415.title: Age of Loop for Wireless Networked Control Systems Optimization
arxiv-2106-00415.creator: Pedro M. de Sant Ana 1 , Nikolaj Marchenko 1 , Petar Popovski 2 and Beatriz Soret 2
arxiv-2106-00415.description: Abstract Joint design of control and communication in Wireless Networked Control Systems (WNCS) is a promising approach for future wireless industrial applications. In this context, Age of Information (AoI) has been increasingly utilized as a metric that is more representative than latency in the context of systems with a sense-compute-actuate cycle.

arxiv-2110-03420.title: RHH-LGP: Receding Horizon And Heuristics-Based Logic-Geometric Programming For Task And Motion Planning
arxiv-2110-03420.creator: Cornelius V. Braun, Joaquim Ortiz-Haro, Marc Toussaint, Ozgur S. Oguz
arxiv-2110-03420.description: Abstract Sequential decision-making and motion planning for robotic manipulation induce combinatorial complexity. For long-horizon tasks, especially when the environment comprises many objects that can be interacted with, planning efficiency becomes even more important. To plan such long-horizon tasks, we present the RHH-LGP algorithm for combined task and motion planning (TAMP).

arxiv-2207-01047.title: An Empirical Study of Flaky Tests in JavaScript
arxiv-2207-01047.creator: Negar Hashemi 1 , Amjed Tahir 2 and Shawn Rasheed 3
arxiv-2207-01047.description: Abstract Flaky tests (tests with non-deterministic outcomes) can be problematic for testing efficiency and software reliability. Flaky tests in test suites can also significantly delay software releases. There have been several studies that attempt to quantify the impact of test flakiness in different programming languages (e.g., Java and Python) and application domains (e.g., mobile and GUI-based).

arxiv-2302-00637.title: Equivariant smoothing of cusp singularities
arxiv-2302-00637.creator: Yunfeng Jiang
arxiv-2302-00637.description: Abstract . We generalize Looijenga’s conjecture for smoothing surface cusp singularities to the equivariant setting. Moreover, we prove that for any cusp singularity which admits a one-parameter smoothing, the smoothing can always be induced by smoothing of locally complete intersection cusps. The result provides evidence for the existence of the moduli stack of lci \lci covers over semi-log-canonical surfaces. 1.

arxiv-2501-11942.creator: Minfeng Qi 1,∗ , Qin Wang 2,∗ , Ningran Li 3 , Shiping Chen 2 , Tianqing Zhu 1
arxiv-2501-11942.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce and implement BRC20 sniping attack . Our attack manipulates the BRC20 token transfers in open markets and disrupts the fairness among bidding participants. The long-standing principle of "highest bidder wins" is rendered ineffective.

pmc-11329660.title: Gd-doped ceria with extraordinary oxygen-ion conductivity for low temperature solid oxide fuel cells
pmc-11329660.creator: Prerna Vinchhi, Abhijit Ray, Kaushik Mallik, Ranjan Pati
pmc-11329660.description: Doped ceria has been extensively explored as an efficient electrolyte material for intermediate to low temperature solid oxide fuel cell. Among other ceria electrolytes, gadolinia doped ceria (GDC) is one of the most extensively studied electrolyte materials for low temperature SOFC applications.

pmc-11390264.title: Investigation and quantification of composition variability in urinary stone analysis
pmc-11390264.creator: Binh Duy Le, Kyung-Jin Oh, Anh Tuan Le, Long Hoang, Ilwoo Park
pmc-11390264.description: PurposeTo investigate the variability in urinary stone composition analysis due to sampling and suggest potential solutions.Materials and MethodsWe collected 1,135 stone fragments from 149 instances that had undergone a stone removal at Hanoi Medical University Hospital from January 2022 to August 2022. Each fragment was ground into fine powder and divided into separate specimens if the amount was abundant.

pmc-11715726.title: Estimating Alzheimer's Disease Progression Score Using Machine Learning on FreeSurfer‐Derived MRI Gray Matter Volumes
pmc-11715726.creator: Junhyoun Sung, Dean Shibata, Kwun Chuen Gary Chan, Lan Shui, David R Haynor
pmc-11715726.description: BackgroundThe early diagnosis and monitoring of Alzheimer's disease (AD) presents a significant challenge due to its heterogeneous nature, which includes variability in cognitive symptoms, diagnostic test results, and progression rates. This study aims to enhance the understanding of AD progression by integrating neuroimaging metrics with demographic data using a novel machine learning technique.

pmc-12369069.title: ANO5 p.I616F variant drives florid cemento-osseous dysplasia by disrupting transmembrane domain structure
pmc-12369069.creator: Lanlan Zhang, Wenxi Jin, Yunfa Qin, Yonghui Zhang, Yemei Qian, Jingyi Li, Yu Liu, Yan’an Shi, Rongju Xie, Weihong Wang
pmc-12369069.description: BackgroundTo date, genetic studies on florid cemento-osseous dysplasia (FCOD) remain limited. This study aimed to elucidate the clinical features and genetic basis of FCOD in Chinese populations, with particular emphasis on identifying pathogenic ANO5 variants and their mechanistic contributions to disease development.

pmc-12512296.title: Advancing quadruple helix theory for health systems innovation: evidence from Ageing@Coimbra
pmc-12512296.creator: Alessandra Ricciardelli, Lorenzo Mercurio, Claudia Salvatore
pmc-12512296.description: BackgroundSocietal challenges in public health call for innovation to enhance health outcomes and equity. This study explores the application of the Quadruple Helix (QH) model—engaging academia, government, industry, and civil society—in driving healthcare innovation at the regional level.MethodsA qualitative case study approach was adopted, focusing on the Ageing@Coimbra Reference Site.

pmc-12603585.title: Using eHealth to Support Quality of Life and Well-Being in Patients With Lung Cancer: Systematic Review
pmc-12603585.creator: Virginia Harrison, Katie Jones, Caroline AC Hyde, Naomi Cahill, Dara Bracken-Clarke, Zoe Davey, Jane Frankland
pmc-12603585.description: BackgroundLung cancer (LC) is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide and has a substantial impact on patients’ quality of life (QoL) and psychological well-being, due to complex physical, emotional, and social challenges. Addressing these needs is critical; yet, many patients go unsupported.

pmc-12957291.title: Biomimetic actuator crafted from a relaxor ferroelectric polymer nanocomposite
pmc-12957291.creator: Hui Chi, Peijia Bai, Zhengxue Zhou, Guangfa Wang, Wenhan Xu, Yu Zhang, Hao Qin, Xinru Wang, Yunhe Zhang, Rujun Ma
pmc-12957291.description: Soft actuators have garnered widespread attention due to their distributed actuation and high error tolerance. However, fabricating biomimetic actuators with small-size, simple structure, low energy consumption, and multifunctionality remains challenging. Here, we present a monolayer nanocomposite achieved by incorporating polymer dots into a polyvinylidene fluoride terpolymer.

pmc-13107444.title: Exploiting the Photoresponse in LiInP2Se6 for Image Processing
pmc-13107444.creator: Anshul Rasyotra, Anirban Chowdhury, Dipanjan Sen, Subir Ghosh, Arpan Ghosh, Rui Gusmao, Divya Somvanshi, Joan M. Redwing, Zdenek Sofer, Saptarshi Das
pmc-13107444.description: We report an anomalous photoresponse in LiInP2Se6-gated monolayer MoS2 field effect transistors (FETs), driven by sub-bandgap photocarrier excitation and relaxation in LiInP2Se6. The MoS2/LiInP2Se6 heterostructure exhibits gate-tunable persistent negative photoconductivity, a rare phenomenon in 2D FET platforms. Notably, the photoconductivity change scales with incident light intensity, with weaker illumination producing slower, smaller responses and stronger illumination inducing faster, stronger suppression.

pmc-13447999.title: Contexts, mechanisms and outcomes of home-based palliative care implementation in low- and middle-income countries: A realist review
pmc-13447999.creator: Duong Dai Le, Khoa Duy Duong, Anna Peeler, Mevhibe Hocaoglu, Charles Normand, Irene Higginson, Richard Harding
pmc-13447999.description: BackgroundIn 2015, an estimated 16.4 million people in low-and-middle-income countries (LMICs) died with serious health-related suffering requiring palliative care. Yet access to palliative care remains limited in LMICs, where the gaps are greatest. Home-based palliative care (HBPC) has been shown to improve access, enhance quality of life and reduce costs.

pmc-13490586.title: Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) coupled with machine learning for classification of paddy soils from non-granary cultivation systems
pmc-13490586.creator: Zubaidah Yusop, Khairul Fikri Tamrin
pmc-13490586.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Soil nutrients variability plays a crucial role in paddy growth and yield. Insufficient information on soil nutrient content can lead to inefficient fertilizers application, resulting in either nutrient deficiency or excess in the soil. This study investigates the potential of laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) combined with machine learning for rapid classification of paddy soils from non-granary cultivation systems in Sarawak, Malaysia.
